description: Planning errors (RFC 0003 §4.3), in the order they are checked.

vectors.description: A namespace can't contain a slash.
An invalid namespace is reported before an invalid maximum offset.
A maximumReminderOffset longer than seven days is invalid.
An invalid maximum is reported before any settings are asked.
A before-reminder of zero isn't positive.
vectors.provenance: RFC 0003 §4.3 Errors 3: an offset that isn't positive is rejected.

vectors.description: A before-reminder longer than maximumReminderOffset is rejected.
An after-reminder exactly maximumReminderOffset long is accepted.
Two prayers have bad offsets; the first known event in events order (the query's first Isha, the evening before the range) is reported, before-reminder first.
vectors.provenance: RFC 0003 §4.3 Errors 3 (subjects in events order, before before after).

vectors.description: Friday 5 June publishes no Dhuhr, and the Jumu'ah settings have a zero reminder: the gap's .jumuah subject is rejected.
vectors.provenance: RFC 0003 §4.3 Errors 3 (a Friday's Dhuhr gap asks both observances).

vectors.description: Both the ordinary and the Jumu'ah settings for Friday's missing Dhuhr have bad reminders: the ordinary subject is asked first and reported.
A bad offset for a prayer that only a gap holds is rejected as well.
vectors.provenance: RFC 0003 §4.3 Errors 3 (gap subjects follow the events).
